title: Audio Capture
text: Capture audio samples from an input audio device and send to an algorithm, 1 input, 1 output, {Data type} sets Data type of audio device; {Number of channels} sets the number of data channels, {Samples per frame} sets the size of data vector read from audio device and {Sample time}. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: msg
ports.summary: Data message from audio capture interface scalar

ports.name: data
ports.summary: Data frame from captured audio M -element vector | M -by- C matrix

params.name: Data type
params.values: Data type of audio device int16 (default) | int8 | int32

params.name: Number of channels
params.values: Number of data channels 2 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Samples per frame
params.values: Size of data vector read from audio device 4410 (default) | positive scalar integer

params.name: Sample time
params.values: Sample time in seconds -1 (default) | positive scalar
